join-group-order-limit.sql:
select c.REGION, sum(o.AMOUNT) as TOTAL_AMOUNT, count(*) as ORDERS
from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') o
join i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.CUSTOMERS') c on o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
where o.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
group by c.REGION
order by TOTAL_AMOUNT desc
limit 10

where-mixed.sql: select ORDER_ID from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') where (STATUS in ('ACTIVE', 'HELD') or STATUS like 'P%') and AMOUNT between 10 and 500 and CUSTOMER_ID is not null and not (REGION = 'EMEA' or REGION is null)

computed.sql: select ORDER_ID, (AMOUNT + 1) * 1.2 as GROSS, AMOUNT - (FEE - 1) as NET, -AMOUNT as NEGATIVE, upper(STATUS) as ST, case when AMOUNT > 100 then 'big' else 'small' end as SIZE, case STATUS when 'A' then 1 else 0 end as FLAG, coalesce(STATUS, 'it''s none') as S2, cast(AMOUNT as integer) as WHOLE, cast(AMOUNT as numeric(18, 2)) as FIXED, extract(year from ORDER_DATE) as YR, STATUS || '-x' as TAG from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS')

having-distinct.sql: select distinct CUSTOMER_ID, count(distinct STATUS) as STATUSES from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') group by CUSTOMER_ID having sum(AMOUNT) > 1000 and count(*) <> 1

order-offset.sql: select ORDER_ID, AMOUNT from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') order by AMOUNT desc nulls last, ORDER_ID limit 10 offset 20

joins.sql: select o.ORDER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, p.TITLE from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') o left join i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.CUSTOMERS') c on o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID and c.REGION <> 'NONE' full outer join p('shop::Product.products') p using (PRODUCT_ID) cross join tb('shop::Store.SALES.REGIONS') r

right-join-comma.sql: select * from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') o right join i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.CUSTOMERS') c on o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID, SALES.REGIONS

var-let.sql: select REGION, sum(AMOUNT) as TOTAL_AMOUNT from var('active') a where a.ORDER_DATE > var('since') group by REGION

func-csv-service.sql:
select f.ORDER_ID from func('shop::orders::ordersOver_Integer_1__Relation_1_', minimum => 100) f join csv('a,b
1,2') c on f.ORDER_ID = c.a join service('/orders') s on s.ID = f.ORDER_ID

subquery.sql: select t.STATUS, t.TOTAL from (select STATUS, sum(AMOUNT) as TOTAL from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') group by STATUS) t where t.TOTAL > 100

ctes.sql: with totals as (select CUSTOMER_ID, sum(AMOUNT) as TOTAL from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') group by CUSTOMER_ID), big (CID, TOTAL) as (select * from totals where TOTAL > 1000) select n.CUSTOMER_NAME, b.TOTAL from big b join i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.CUSTOMERS') n on b.CID = n.CUSTOMER_ID

union-all.sql: select ORDER_ID, AMOUNT from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') where STATUS = 'ACTIVE' union all select ORDER_ID, AMOUNT from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ARCHIVE') order by AMOUNT limit 5

except.sql: select CUSTOMER_ID from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.CUSTOMERS') except select CUSTOMER_ID from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS')

window.sql: select ORDER_ID, row_number() over (partition by CUSTOMER_ID order by AMOUNT desc) as RN, sum(AMOUNT) over (partition by CUSTOMER_ID) as CUSTOMER_TOTAL from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS')

in-subquery.sql: select * from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') where CUSTOMER_ID in (select CUSTOMER_ID from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.CUSTOMERS') where REGION = 'EMEA')

exists.sql: select * from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.CUSTOMERS') c where exists (select 1 from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') o where o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID)

recursive.sql: with recursive t as (select 1 as N union all select N + 1 from t where N < 5) select N from t

window-frame.sql: select ORDER_ID, sum(AMOUNT) over (order by ORDER_DATE rows between 2 preceding and current row) as MOVING from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS')

named-window.sql: select ORDER_ID, sum(AMOUNT) over w as T from i('shop::ingest::OrdersIngest.ORDERS') window w as (partition by CUSTOMER_ID)
